uzo.purpose: Sets its children one below the other with the gap of a spacing step, aligned and placed along the column.

instead.kialo: Children that stand beside each other are a row, because a column would put them below each other and the eye would lose that they belong together.

boundary.kialo: Columns of different heights that fill each other's gaps are a layout of the page, because the reading order then jumps between them; a person decides it.

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: A section of a page holds its Eroj in a column, because the section decides how its parts stand to each other and the layout Ero takes that gap from a spacing step.

with.kialo: The fields of a form stand in a column, because a person fills them in one after the other.
A column holds rows, because a screen stands its groups one below the other and lays the parts of a group side by side.

case.en: The children should stand side by side.

case.de: Die Kinder sollen nur über die volle Breite untereinander stehen, ohne Ausrichtung.
case.en: The children only stack over the full width, without alignment.

do.de: Nimm den Abstand aus den Stufen der Spalte (gap) und richte die Kinder mit align quer zu ihr aus.
do.en: Take the gap from the steps of the column (gap) and align the children across it with align.

do.de: Nutze justify nur, wo die Spalte eine eigene Höhe hat, damit die Kinder Raum haben, sich entlang zu verteilen.
do.en: Use justify only where the column has a height of its own, so the children have room to move along it.

dont.de: Dem Layout eine Farbe, einen Rand oder eine Schrift geben; es ordnet nur seine Kinder an, eine Fläche ist die der karto.
dont.en: Give the layout a colour, a border or a font; it only places its children, a surface is the karto's.

dont.de: Den Kindern einen Außenabstand geben, um sie zu trennen; der gap des Layouts ist der eine Abstand zwischen ihnen.
dont.en: Write a margin on the children to space them; the gap of the layout is the one distance between them.

none.de: Das Layout nimmt weder den Fokus noch eine Taste; seine Kinder behalten ihre eigene Reihenfolge beim Lesen und mit Tab.
none.en: The layout takes neither the focus nor a key; its children keep their own order in the reading and the tab sequence.
